sql: /* Query 9: filter5_join1 (player, team) */ SELECT player.name, player.position, team.championship, team.founded_year FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name WHERE player.name = 'Kobe Bean Bryant' OR player.fiba_world_cup >= 0 OR team.championship <> 3

name.description: full name of the NBA player (e.g., LeBron James).

position.description: player's primary position on the team; choose one from ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt'].

championship.description: championships is the number of this team getting championships (e.g. 5).

founded_year.description: founded_year is the year of this team team founded (e.g. 1947).
